info.title: Keywell admin API
info.description: Manage Keywell's members, groups, applications and service accounts, and read the audit log. Send an API token, made on the admin Service accounts page, as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". A read-only token can only use GET. Each token can make 600 requests a minute. Bodies are JSON objects of at most 1 MiB; unknown fields are refused. Times are RFC 3339 in UTC, and unset times are null. Every error is {"error": "code", "message": "..."}.

id_token_ttl.description: Seconds, from 60 to 86400. Leave out, or send 0, for the global default.

patch.description: Send only the fields to change; a field left out is kept. Sending null for a lifetime goes back to the global default, and null for service_account_id turns machine sign-in off. Changing client_type to confidential makes a secret, which is in the response and can't be shown again. Changing it to public removes the secret. Replacing icon_url deletes the old icon file if the app uploaded it.
